title: Venezuelan Plantain Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with sautéed plantains and a tangy kiss of flavor. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Slice the plantain into 1-inch rounds and cook until golden brown.
Place the cooked plantain on the wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Sprinkle the melted cheese over the plantain.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
